title: Training data for net1's traffic head: the fixed rule on training links, alone, against stock flows and as copies
description: net1 v6's beliefs lose what tells copies from a stock competitor, which the raw measurements keep (exp-net2-competitor-info-177: 0.753 against 0.496 balanced accuracy on held-out validation links). This gathers training data for a head that estimates it as part of net1 (src/expliccit_env/train/traffic.py): the fixed rule on net1 v6 (u = 0.25) as the observed flow on the training links (campaign seed 1, 30 s) under the new family's conditions (Cubic from 0 s, BBRv1 from 4 s, Cubic from 2 s and 10 s, random loss) and as 1, 2 and 4 copies, observations kept. The held-out competitors (BBRv3, Westwood) stay out, for evaluation. experiments/traffic_head.py reports the head's accuracy on training links held out of its fit and saves the head trained on all of them (traffic_head.pt).
prepare: N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6" "$N" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for f in new; do uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$f" --split train --family "$f" --duration-ms 30000 --seed 1 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$f/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$f"; done; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split train --duration-ms 30000 --seed 1 --n 1 2 4 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
